_readme: Tuning numbers. Change them and reload; no code needed.
solo: energyCost = share of her max energy a solo night costs; clientCap = most clients she'll see that week afterward; lustDrop = how much it lowers her lust.

lovers: neglectWeeks = weeks in a row without Sam before she feels left out (when another lover isn't); missedMood = mood lost each week she's restless and Sam doesn't see her; jealousyChance = weekly odds of that event. Shared scenes are tuned in bonds.json.

breakup: mood / trust = what ending it costs her (Loyal ladies lose half the trust); rekindleTrust = trust she needs before Sam can ask her back; rekindleChance = base odds she says yes (better if she's happy); rekindleCooldown = weeks between attempts.
lust: low = below this she turns down the heavier services; eager = she's in the mood (bonuses below); high = 'restless' (solo nights, reckless nights, lovers come looking for Sam).
lust.build: weekly gain = base + lewdness*perLewd (+eagerTrait for Eager/Exhibitionist, +demon, +resting), times her personality's lustBuild and trait multipliers.

lust.drop: how much each thing lowers it right away: client = per client service (+fav if it's her favorite), private = private time with Sam, train = practicing a service with Sam. Lewder ladies drop less per act (dropAtLewd0 → dropAtLewd100).
lust.profile.floorPerLewd: her lust never falls below lewdness × this (a very lewd lady is never fully sated).
lust.traits: Insatiable / Slow to Warm multipliers (build, drop), plus floor and max. Slow to Warm ladies top out below 'restless'. traitChance = odds a lady has the trait.
lust.bonus: extra mood/trust from private time with Sam when she's eager or restless (trainMult scales it for practice sessions); clientMood = mood per client service while eager.

renewal: her willingness = (trust×0.6 + mood×0.4)/100 (+loyal for Loyal ladies). At freeAt or above she re-signs for free; below that the fee scales up toward feeWeeks × her wage; below refuseBelow she's thinking of leaving and may say no. raise = size of the raise option; raiseBoost = how much it helps her willingness.

wages: contracts renew at her current going rate (wageFor, which rises with her skills and popularity). Between renewals she asks for a raise once her wage falls below askAt × her going rate (askAtAmbitious for Ambitious/Greedy).
mood: restingPoint = the mood she drifts back toward each week (drift = how fast); overworkAt = how many clients a week before she feels overworked.
income.escort: multiplier on all escort and off-duty service fees.

ngplus: New Game+ (after paying off the debt). New debt = (your original house's debt + the new house's debt) × debtShare, +perCycle for each cycle after the second. purse = gold Sam keeps in hand; savings above it go straight to the new debt. Houses other than the original are sold for saleValue × their price, also paid toward the debt. samKeep = share of Sam's stats he keeps (1 = all).

jobPrefs._note: Rolled job likes/dislikes for generic ladies (and named ones without their own list). Each job's odds: base, plus personality (personalities.json jobsUp/jobsDown), plus trait for each matching trait below, plus ownJob for the job she arrives in. maxLikes/maxDislikes cap the lists.
